crossRefs.note: “ ‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.
But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like…

translations.web: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,
translations.bsb: except for his immediate family—his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,
translations.kjv: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
translations.asv: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
